records.task: Locate the cortical outline around the retained fatty hilum and confirm its AP span at the saved short-axis frame.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: All saved endpoint coordinates equal baseline, including the 9.2 mm AP span, 28 mm long axis and the 3.8 and 4.4 mm cortical chords. The off-axis notch starts on the posterior side and leaves the measured anterior wall intact.
scoreEvidence.form: Chang Figure 1C supports a continuous elongated cortex and a visible eccentric thickening. The model retains a smooth oval perimeter and a displaced hilar region, but its modest hilar-side indentation does not reproduce the source’s pronounced focal outer bulge.
scoreEvidence.readability: The live view locates the node at the high axillary window. The slice confirms cortex and hilum. The neutral reverse view distinguishes the shallow indentation at isolation scale.
scoreEvidence.economy: The 720-triangle shell replaces 1,656 baseline triangles. A denser 1,656-triangle profile lowered maximum sampled error from 0.14 to 0.07 mm, without improving the observed calibrated cortex landmark.

records.task: Distinguish the elongated opposite axillary node and thin cortex from the displaced hilum and thick cortex on the modeled right.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The opposite case has a 26 mm outer long axis, 9.2 mm AP outer dimension and 2.8 mm saved cortical chord. The caliper endpoints are unchanged. It uses independent case geometry from the 28 mm right node.
scoreEvidence.form: Chang Figure 1B supports the elongated, smoothly outlined normal oval and central echogenic hilum. The oval boundary is continuous in the neutral and reverse captures, and the acquired and modeled sections preserve the same nested cortex–hilum relation.
scoreEvidence.readability: The default longitudinal grayscale scan labels the outer cortex and retained central fatty hilum and shows the saved 2.8 mm caliper. The alternate view shows the boundary from behind.
scoreEvidence.economy: The 720-triangle profile uses 56.5% fewer triangles than the 1,656-triangle baseline. Maximum sampled deviation is 0.14 mm, versus 0.06 mm in the denser trial.

records.note: The acquired reference is a separate normal example at its own scale. The 2.8 mm caliper and 26 mm outer length are from this authored left node.
